rationale_overall: Q1 2023 news reinforced rather than undermined every current thesis leg: Microsoft's ~$10B OpenAI investment (2023-01-23) cements its AI-wave leadership even as NVDA's Q4 FY23 print showed data-center revenue still soft QoQ, consistent with AI still being early/buildup rather than crested; Lockheed's record $150B backlog (+11% YoY, reported 2023-01-24) reaffirms the defense/geopolitical thesis amid sustained Western rearmament; Rocket Lab kept signing new Electron manifest (Capella, NASA TROPICS, HawkEye 360) reaffirming the rockets/spacecraft leg; and NuScale hit a genuine milestone (first NRC-certified SMR design, 2023-01-19) that outweighs the concurrent UAMPS cost update. None of the five clears the bar for removal, so under the tight 5-ticker cap there is no room to add a robotics or quantum name this quarter without an unsupported swap — that gap (robotics, quantum both still unrepresented) is a known limitation to revisit once a current holding's thesis weakens.
